visual.general_description: Photograph of two infant whole-body radiograph films (infantogram).
visual.detailed_description: Photograph of two infant radiograph films hanging from two brown clips against a dark background. The left film shows a frontal whole-body view of an infant with both arms raised, a large rounded skull, ribs, spine, pelvis and both legs, with an "R" marker at the lower left. The right film shows a second view of the trunk, pelvis and legs with an "R" marker at its center and the feet at the lower right. Dim header text with a date-like and time-like stamp and name-like lines is printed along the top of both films; it is only partly legible at this resolution and is deliberately not transcribed. "KATHMANDU MEDICAL COLLEGE" is printed along the bottom of each film. Soft tissue calcification is not distinguishable at this image resolution.
